name: resume-across-runs
description: A second run opens in the same session root as the first. It shares the root; it does not carry the first conversation into the second - measured 2026-10-05: asked what it had done, the second run answered that it did not know. The host's own --continue / --session is what carries a conversation.
requires: --reuse-session with the same --session-dir on both runs; the test drives both, and it holds the shared root rather than the conversation

steps.message: Read the project instruction and state one risk.
